svg.text: Platform 300 x 120: three rails 300 long (center and both sides) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three cross bars 120 long, at both ends and the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Struts: one from each rear corner down to the dropout eyelet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (about 300 long); flatten 30 at the end and weld on a 3 mm tab.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stays: one from each front corner down to the boss on the seat stay

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (about 120 long), with a 3 mm tab at the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each tab 5.5 for an M5 bolt. Weld with the rack in a jig

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: taken off the frame so the tabs land on the eyelets and bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the saddle by at least 20 at the lowest setting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
